summary: cli_parse engines: native, xml, textfsm, ntc_templates, ttp, pyats and json, extensible via any collection. Red Hat fully supports native and json; support for ntc_templates, pyATS, textfsm and xmltodict is limited to their public APIs.
questions: Which parsing engines does cli_parse support?
Which cli_parse parsers are supported by Red Hat?
Can I add my own parsing engine to cli_parse?

answer_card.title: cli_parse parsing engines
answer_card.answer_md:
- `native`: built in, no extra libraries
- `xml`: XML to native data
- `textfsm`: template-based state machine
- `ntc_templates`: prebuilt textfsm templates for many platforms
- `ttp`: template-based parsing library
- `pyats`: Cisco pyATS parsers
- `json`: JSON output to native data

Any collection can add engines. With an Ansible Automation Platform subscription, `native` and `json` are fully supported; `ntc_templates`, pyATS, `textfsm` and `xmltodict` are supported only for their documented public APIs.
